verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents an official command-line interface covering scraping, crawling, exports, schedules and dedicated APIs. It lists concrete subcommands such as `scrapingbee crawl` and `scrapingbee schedule`, and a probe confirms an official CLI repo on GitHub. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, deeper documentation of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows (the schedule command is also a gated advanced feature).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
`scrapingbee crawl` | Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
`scrapingbee schedule` | Cron-based scheduled jobs; gated advanced feature.
